strengths: The message reads at a glance: bars and nearly all dots sit well above zero under noise and around zero on clean labels
The one noisy run below zero (breast cancer, 20%) is plainly visible, and the error bar crossing zero, with the matching caption sentence, shows the weak case honestly
The y axis includes zero, and the sd of the paired differences and all five seed dots are shown, with dot offsets that keep the error bars and caps clear
The zero line takes the logistic regression color of Fig. 1(c), a sound departure from the planned gray that keeps gray for the clean-label reference; the caption explains the line
Setting order, dataset grouping, x label, dot style and the accent color for ours match Fig. 1
The y label names the quantity, the direction of the difference and the unit, and now fits the height of the axis
No legend is needed, and there is no clipped or overlapping text and little wasted space
